verdict.rationale: Noise suppression is a fair capability to ask of a voice agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of noise suppression, audio filtering, or background-noise handling. Barge-in and the Twilio audio bridging are related turn-taking features, not audio filtering, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
